A refused SendInput (sent == 0) still flips _phaseOn on every tick and blink-once; an odd refusal count (a lock, a UAC prompt, an elevated foreground window) inverts the cadence and disarms Stop()'s corrective toggle

Every analyze re-runs the XSD-validating parse and GDI+-decodes and tiles the whole sprite sheet on the UI thread through Xml.TryReadXml; the backlog's 'no second decode' refutation read the wrong lines

On the shutdown save, RecordingStopped is posted to the blocked UI thread, so Stop burns the full 10 s per source (20 s by default) and an OS or Restart Manager exit kills the process before the scratch WAVs are finalised
session_ids_by_pid aborts every mode when an agent command line holds a byte cp1252 cannot decode (text=True: reader-thread UnicodeDecodeError leaves stdout None, then an uncaught AttributeError)
transcript_state re-walks all transcripts and re-parses the whole session file per attributed root per sample, and neither --verify nor the CSV can see the cost
--report files unattributed rows ('' pending), sessions quiet for more than 900 s, and no-tool-call (-1) rows into 'clear'

classify_call returns would-prompt/would-allow for argument-less non-command tools where the shipped EvaluateCall returns Undecidable: 3.3% of calls, 14% of auto wouldPrompt, 12% of FILTERING 'still fires', and 3 of the 30 recall positives (README's 93% is the Python's; shipped semantics give 83%)
LogApprovalAttempt's repeat guard also dedupes confirmed presses, so a run of same-shape prompts clicked on consecutive ticks leaves one log line for N clicks
AdapterSuspect bypasses Explain: a live transcript with no tool calls (23% of this box's transcripts) logs 'adapter may be stale' every 10 s for 15 minutes
Apply logs 'held back a notice about ...' on every 10 s tick for as long as a blocked prompt stands, with no repeat guard unlike its two sibling log paths

Codex stand-down allow-lists only `on-request`, so a session under the `untrusted` policy (which prompts before every non-trusted command) is never flagged and is described as one that never stops to ask

RuleLoader reads only the three home-scope settings files, so rules Claude Code writes into <project>/.claude/settings.json or settings.local.json are invisible to both the stall detector and the approvals audit

A session that leaves the 15-minute window and is resumed gets a fresh cursor and a pruned counted set, so its whole history (up to 2000 calls) is tallied again: the audit log repeats the 'approved N call(s)' line and the approvals card can show its older commands above newer ones from other sessions

ActiveTranscripts uses the SearchOption overload (IgnoreInaccessible=false): one ACL-denied subdirectory silently drops every transcript not yet yielded, which is the whole root when the denied directory sits directly under it

FixDanglingComma maps a comma ordinal through comment-STRIPPED text; Disable on an argv.json whose hand-appended port key is the LAST member deletes the wrong comma, VS Code then ignores the whole file at every launch, and the module reports success
Hotkey and tray asks skip the fullscreen stand-down that the drop and poke honour
Under the default 'unload' residency each audition sample and each repeat-guard retry is a separate cold model load
A UTF-8 BOM or UTF-16 encoding makes ai-settings.json 'Unreadable'; when a .bak exists recovery overwrites the primary with backupPath=null, destroying the rejected file and the last save silently

A cloud provider with no cloud model set passes CanUse, and the brain sends the LOCAL default 'gemma3:4b' to the cloud endpoint: 400 and silence with local fallback on (the default), or substitution to the provider's first-listed model with it off

On Vision=null (/v1) backends the stale name-marker list is the sole vision gate in both the vision dropdowns and ChooseModel, so a working vision model with no marker cannot be picked and is refused ('none-usable'), or, if configured by file or migration, is silently substituted by another vendor's model

FallbackBackend cannot be enumerated, so with 'Use local provider as fallback' on (the default) a cloud model id is never re-validated and BUG-002's spoken advisory never fires: a bad cloud id is silence logged as 'backend-unreachable', while the pane's Refresh/Test buttons can see the same list

FallbackBackend probes cloud then local sequentially and each probe borrows the 120 s generation deadline; a provider whose traffic is silently dropped costs ~240 s of AI silence per ask (Fortunes still answers) and delays launch auto-start by 120 s

WarmUpAsync hard-codes keep_alive '10m', so under 'Keep loaded while the app runs' the launch warm-up expires after ten idle minutes and the first remark pays the cold load the setting exists to avoid, while the pane and Readme say it stays loaded for the session

OpenAiCompatBackend.IsAvailableAsync reports an answered 401/403/404 as 'not reachable' and DescribeError files every AiBackendHttpException under 'backend-unreachable', so Test connection (OpenAI) and the runtime log misdescribe a bad cloud key; the resulting silence is by design
Stop()'s corrective-toggle body (ScrollLockBlinker.cs:179-183) is unasserted: the stopProbe check only catches the early-return regression, so deleting the toggle leaves the suite green

Start() zeroes _phaseOn without reconciling a key it lit: off -> 'Blink once now' -> enable inverts the cadence and re-arms the stuck-lit LED; the 1.0.5 fix lives only in Stop(), which the enable path never calls
Import runs the importer synchronously on the UI thread, contradicting its own worker-thread contract (about 2.5 s per click with the full catalog installed, mostly re-parsing existing packs)
Every import re-reads and fully re-parses every existing pack just to count rows, then RebuildEngine parses them again (about 1.2 s each with the full catalog)
Corpus parse runs on the UI thread at startup and after every folder change; about 0.25 s by default and 1.2-1.4 s once the user has downloaded the full catalog; the folder cache is all-or-nothing

An undeclared tagged pack with one malformed row is silently re-read as prose that speaks its own metadata; all 158 shipped packs are undeclared and nothing validates pack rows before or after download

VectorCache retains a raw copy of every pooled vector for the picker's lifetime after the final Save, doubling vector memory (about 5 MB by default, about 90 MB with the full catalog); bounded, not a leak
Warm's early exits (model asset absent, pool over 100k) never set StoodDown, so 'Rebuild smart index' answers 'Indexing N fortunes in the background' on every press
Cold-warm checkpoint every 2048 pool entries re-parses and rewrites the entire cache.bin, so checkpoint I/O grows with the square of the new-line count (derived from the code, not measured)
'smart picker ready (N lines indexed)' is logged the moment Warm has queued its task; completion and cancellation of the warm are never logged
Smart-index status derives 'enabled' from `_smart != null`, so 'Rebuild smart index' answers 'Smart picks are off' while the picker is being rebuilt, and the 1.0.10 stand-down text is unreachable

'Rebuild smart index' currency guard hashes the same immutable list its baseline came from, so once the index is complete the button is a no-op that reports 'already built for these N fortunes' even after the fortunes folder changed on disk
Surface-pose growth stops at flip-action turns: the bundled sheep's ceiling walk reads MOVE, its wall descent Idle, and its wall-bounce `boing` reads CLIMB; the fixture check cannot fail on it
Zip import: _importing is set only after the extraction await, so a second Import (or closing) during extraction deletes the tree the extractor is writing and the second pick is then refused
Loopback capture delivers no packets while no render stream is active and the mixer pads no gaps, so the system track lands early relative to the microphone
Scratch WAVs (recording.system.wav / recording.mic.wav) and failed-start stubs match no purge shape, so raw audio from any abnormal end is kept forever against the 72-hour promise
Map-reduce stops folding notes after ~8000 characters and writes the result as a complete summary with no coverage marker
Exiting within the save/mix window after a normal stop truncates recording.wav: the save task is untracked and shutdown only checks _recording
whisper-cli is killed at a fixed 30 minutes regardless of recording length or model, and the in-app retry hits the same cap
Remembrance 'Open the download pages…' opens whisper.cpp releases/latest, which upstream's tagging makes permanently asset-less, and reports '✓ opened … Save both'; shipped in 1.0.16

CachingCalendarSource's refresh latch has no deadline: an Outlook COM fetch that blocks (Object Model Guard prompt, hung Outlook) silently freezes that slot until the call returns or an options Apply rebuilds the source

IcsUrlSource.Download: the 20 s HttpClient timeout stops at the headers (ResponseHeadersRead) and the 8 MiB cap is checked only after a chunked body is fully buffered, so a stalled feed pins that slot's refresh latch until an Apply or restart
Calendar, personal and briefing reminders are marked fired before delivery is checked; with no companion on screen SayAll drops the bubble and the reminder is spent (chime still plays)

Every Reminders Apply rebuilds all configured sources, discarding each slot's cache and last-good list and re-fetching every URL, Outlook and file slot; the tray reads 'nothing upcoming' for the next 20 s
Fired-id set is never pruned while any slot errors persistently, so a healthy slot beside a misconfigured or Outlook-closed slot grows the persisted set without bound

Publish guard checks only modules/<Name> for uncommitted changes, while the freshness watch set also covers ModuleKit and source-linked files, so a dirty external edit can be baked into a committed zip that no re-zip can re-commit
First publish writes the new modules.json entry without minHostVersion, and the strict-mode catalog generator then throws on it after the commit has landed
No module declares ModulePermissions.LaunchProcess although AiBrain, Remembrance and PetStudio spawn processes; the flag has disclosed nothing since it shipped in 1.2.5

AudioOutput never observes DirectSoundOut's asynchronous device failure: the default-device fallback and _unavailable latch are unreachable, a dead output stays _started for the session, and PlayOwned/PlayNotification (and the Preferences preview) report success into a mixer nobody reads
CheckTopWindow rejects every occluder whose title bar lies entirely above screen y=0, disabling coverage detection for pets on a monitor positioned above the primary
Fullscreen scan excludes only root pet handles, so a TopMost child pet or speech bubble covering a monitor's centre decides that monitor as clear and keeps the pet visible over a fullscreen game

RemoteCatalog self-test's pack-file-cap check reads the host FortunePackLoadPolicy.MaximumFiles, whose only reader is that check; the cap that governs loading is the Fortunes module's separate copy, so the 128-vs-512 regression it describes would pass
Pending removal marker is cleared even when the install-folder delete threw, so an uninstall blocked by a sibling instance or a transient lock is lost and leaves a half-deleted module folder

Every changed settings field is a synchronous full-document durable rewrite on the UI thread (~130 ms at the default pet's 1.17 MB, ~1 s extrapolated at the largest shipped pet) because the active pet's XML is embedded in settings.json
A cancelled or failed install extraction leaves a half-populated modules/<id> folder that the pane lists as 'installed, restart to activate' and the loader then reports as failed

Fixed 820 DIP initial height exceeds the work area of common laptop displays (1366x768, 1080p at 150%); CenterScreen centres on the requested height while Windows clamps the actual height, so the caption and first nav row open above the screen top (and at 1366x768 the bottom edge sits behind the taskbar)

A ReloadPaneAfter action that completes after the user switched panes (or closed the window) rebuilds ITS pane into the content area: nav and content disagree, the other pane's unsaved edits are dropped, and a fresh view of the same pane is overwritten with the stale view's on-screen values
TestModuleKitAtomicFile and TestModuleKitUnicodeBoundaries bind to the production twins compiled into CoreTests, so ModuleKit's AtomicFile and UnicodeTextProgress have no direct regression test
Corrupt-primary recovery group cannot fail on a store that never consults the backup, because the backup holds the default volume 0.3

mutate-diagnostics.py run_wpf never clears the shared %TEMP% marker and ignores exit code and timeout, so a self-test run that dies or cannot write is graded from the previous run's marker (14 of 22 cases, the baseline check and every --only= run)

shimeji-behaviour-soak.py mis-models border eligibility (horizontal=0x06, horizontal+ unmapped to NONE, floor raised as TASKBAR\|HORIZONTAL): measured 30-80% error in the play-share table on converted pets since reground, no change to the climb rate
Wall spokes are emitted with no inbound edge when the skin has no locomotion and no jump-plus-ceiling path, so a valid pet fails acceptance
Audio budget is a fixed 3 MiB independent of sheet size, so a near-cap sheet plus sounds exceeds the 12 MiB XML limit, and only when ffmpeg is present

Bundle anchors come from the manifest's declared sprites.size, never from the decoded bitmaps; 5 of 948 real bundles disagree with their own manifest and would float or clip frames while passing ACCEPTED (none shipped)

WithPort's in-place value rewrite deletes a trailing line comment on the port line when no comma follows the value, contrary to its comment

Model inventory is taken once per brain (and never when AutoStartServer is off under Unload/Server residency); a model pulled mid-session stays 'missing' and the pane's Refresh models does not reach the brain

Normalize restores a default for every invalid selector except Endpoint and Hotkey, whose empty form survives and is handled three different ways downstream

FallbackBackend.LocalModelFor routes every fallback, including OCR text asks, to the local vision model when CloudTextModel equals CloudVisionModel

FilterSelfTest's and Embedder.SelfTest's failure detail go to temp files nothing reads; the probe, the gate and CI see only PASS/FAIL for both
